subject: chemistry
content: Find the solubility product of a saturated solution of Ag<sub>2</sub>CrO<sub>4</sub> in water at 298 K if the emf of the cell Ag|Ag<sup>+</sup> (satd. Ag<sub>2</sub>CrO<sub>4</sub> soln.) || Ag<sup>+</sup> (0.1 M) | Ag is 0.164 V at 298 K.
